script:
ip addr add 10.9.0.11/24 dev eth0; ip link set eth0 up; echo up-a
ping -c 3 10.9.0.12; echo ping=$?
echo hello-from-a | nc -w 2 10.9.0.12 7007; echo tcp=$?
ip neigh | sort; cat /proc/net/dev; cat /proc/uptime

ip addr add 10.9.0.12/24 dev eth0; ip link set eth0 up; echo up-b
echo reply-from-b | nc -l -p 7007 >/tmp/got; echo served=$?; cat /tmp/got
ip neigh | sort; cat /proc/net/dev; cat /proc/uptime

ip addr add 10.9.0.13/24 dev eth0; ip link set eth0 up; echo up-c
ping -c 2 10.9.0.11; ping -c 2 10.9.0.12; echo ping=$?
ip neigh | sort; cat /proc/net/dev; cat /proc/uptime
